latest_release.name: Reth v2.11.0
latest_release.body:
![image](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/paradigmxyz/reth/main/assets/reth-prod.png)

## Summary

Reth v2.11.0 is a hardening and performance release. RPC calls that can do unbounded work are now capped or cancellable (`eth_callMany`, `trace_callMany`, `debug_traceCallMany`, `eth_getProof`, `mev_simBundle`, `eth_simulateV1`), and the release brings a broad set of transaction pool, P2P and storage correctness fixes. EIP-7702 authorization recovery is parallelized, P2P skips decoding responses it never asked for, and overlay provider setup is cheaper.

SDK users: Ethereum block execution now runs on `evm2::block`, and reth's executor types are thin adapters over it (see Breaking Changes).

## Action Required

- Removed no-op CLI flags. The node now refuses to start if you still pass `--engine.legacy-state-root`, `--engine.caching-and-prewarming`, `--engine.parallel-sparse-trie`, `--engine.disable-parallel-sparse-trie`, `--engine.precompile-cache` or `--rpc-cache.max-headers` (alias `--rpc-cache.max-envs`). Drop them from your config ([#28369](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28369))
- With `--instance N` and no explicit `--auth-ipc.path`, the Engine API IPC socket is now `/tmp/reth_engine_api.ipc-N`. Set `--auth-ipc.path` if your consensus client expects the old path ([#28257](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28257))
- Explicit IPC socket permissions are now validated at startup, and an invalid mode is a startup error. On platforms that can't set the mode before binding (including macOS), explicit permissions fail startup ([#28326](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28326))

- `eth_callMany`, `trace_callMany` and `debug_traceCallMany` now allow at most 1,024 calls and share one `--rpc.gascap` budget across the request. No additional call starts more than five seconds after the first. Previously successful requests may now fail; callers should review request sizes and gas budgets ([#28314](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28314))
- `eth_getProof` now allows at most 1,024 storage keys. `eth_getMultiProof` allows at most 1,024 targets and 1,024 storage keys in total. Requests exceeding these limits fail with invalid params ([#27716](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/27716))

## Backwards Compatibility

**Verification pending:** Database migration and resync requirements, and supported downgrade versions, must be confirmed against the final v2.11.0 release build before publication.

## Update Priority

| User Class | Priority |
|---|---|
| Payload Builders | High |
| Non-Payload Builders | High |

## Breaking Changes

### SDK
- Ethereum block execution moved into `evm2::block`: `BundleState`, `BlockState`/`StateUpdate`, the block execution errors, `GasOutput`/`CommitChanges` and the Ethereum executor now come from evm2, and `EthBlockExecutor` wraps `evm2::block::ethereum::EthBlockExecutor`. `EthApiError::MuxTracerError` now holds the error message ([#28238](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28238))
- `MessageInput` no longer dereferences to bytes. Custom precompile integrations should read inputs through `Evm::message_input` ([#28413](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28413))
- Discovery dependencies moved to discv5 0.12, ENR 0.14 and secp256k1 0.33. Downstream integrations using public discovery/key types must update their dependency versions and key APIs ([#28289](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28289))
- `EnrCombinedKeyWrapper` implements `TryFrom<Enr<SecretKey>>` instead of `From`, and `Discv5::add_node` returns `Error::InvalidEnr` for records the discv5 key backend rejects ([#28345](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28345))
- `RpcServerArgs::auth_ipc_path` is now `Option<String>`; read the effective endpoint with `auth_ipc_path()` ([#28257](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28257))
- `schnellru` caches are replaced with `reth-lru` ([#28291](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/28291))
- Removed the unused `DEFAUL
